 Page No.# 2/3
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Kaushik Goswami
 Order
Date : 11.04.2025 Heard Mr. R. De, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr.
M.P. Goswami, learend Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the State respondent.

This is an application under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 seeking pre-arrest bail to the petitioner i.e.
Sri Gopal Kumar Sarawgi, who is apprehending arrest in connection with Chandmari P.S. Case No.214/2018 registered under Sections 417/420/468/34 of IPC.
Call for case diary, fixing the matter on 25.04.2025.

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the petitioner named above, shall be released on interim pre-arrest bail in connection with the above noted case, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 30,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject, of course, to the following conditions:-
i) That the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer on 17.04.2025,
failing which on and from 18.04.2025, the interim pre-arrest bail order shall have no force;
ii) That the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any persons acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any Police Officer.
Page No.# 3/3 iii) That the petitioner shall refrain from committing any similar offences in future of which he is accused or suspected of commission.
List accordingly.
